TT.text: PROVIDER_CHANGE is not routed by RP002 (FAIL_CLOSED). Not a defect in the consumer; a gap in the router table.
PIPD init does not scaffold schemas/registry.json, so an empty root can never pass doctor.
DEST-10/DEST-15 cannot be implemented because the freeze schema lacks the properties they corrupt; schema extension is a product change.
HGK WorkOrder/Permit issuance has no CLI surface; it lives in hg_kseos.lifecycle. Readback is agent-actionable; issuance is not.
PLAN/VERIFY run on the owner OAuth arm; their attribution comes from the usage ledger rows the relay appends for gpt-6.1-sol, not from the opencode-go shim.
A credential-posture wrapper that cannot return FAIL is weaker than the preflight it wraps; declaring the lane 'secure' from its INCONCLUSIVE would invert the finding.

A launcher defect looks like a card defect: subprocess shell=True picks cmd.exe (env-prefix syntax dies) and bare bash may be WSL's, which cannot see /c/... Both were hit and fixed by pinning git-bash and absolute tool paths.
PIPD fixtures are technology-admission cards, not validation bundles; validate --bundle needs a real bundle with PI-PKG, so the validator still has no POS case on this host.

The R17 prompt's '18 red conformance rerun' does not exist as a suite: scripts/pipd_skills_conformance.py ships 8 skills (6 PASS, 2 PARTIAL, 0 FAIL). Recording a phantom denominator is the same class of error as a fabricated pass, so the real 8 is what is tracked.
